contributions.anchor: the cover's line-1 'Totals for This Report' cell, which is a BARE DASH (no numeral), against 'Totals from Last Report' 1,575.00 = 'Cumulative Totals' 1,575.00
contributions.detail: Form A (p103) was filed and is a completely BLANK printed grid - column headers only, no date, contributor, address or amount in any of its row bands - and its own 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' cell carries only a tiny bare dash (confirmed at 800 dpi), which under the zero-glyph ruling is a nil mark and not a numeral. The cover's own three-column arithmetic closes with nothing in the middle column: 1,575.00 (last) + nothing (this) = 1,575.00 (cumulative), so ZERO itemized rows is exactly right for this period-scoped schedule. The 1,575.00 cumulative is prior-period money reported on this filer's earlier 2024 reports and is not itemized here.

expenditures.anchor: the cover's line-2 'Totals for This Report' cell, also a BARE DASH, against 'Totals from Last Report' 1,519.17 = 'Cumulative Totals' 1,519.17
expenditures.detail: Form B (p104) is likewise a completely BLANK printed grid with only a bare dash on its 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' line. 1,519.17 (last) + nothing (this) = 1,519.17 (cumulative), and the balance line closes the same way (55.83 last = 55.83 cumulative, 1,575.00 - 1,519.17 = 55.83). Zero rows is the correct and complete transcription of this period.
